title.rendered: Exclusive Interview with Sudeep Goenka ji, Goldiee Masale on Glass

content.rendered:
Goldiee Masale’s Sudeep Goenka ji Exclusive Interview:

Goldie Masale’s director Mr. Sudeep Goenka ji spoke exclusively to Ajanta Bottle Private limited and shared his views on Glass packaging. He shared his views on overall glass packaging industry, how it has evolved over the years, benefits of using glass bottles and glass jars and the way forward. He also spoke about Goldie Masale’s association with Ajanta Bottle.
